explain_task.question: Using the revised model’s solver record, explain why the objective drops from 964640.0 to 948640.0 even though the shadow prices on `Year1_Budget` and `Year2_Budget` are unchanged. You must trace the new business rule from `docs/business_requirement.md` to the exact CSV fields `liquidity_policy.csv[Parameter_Name, Value]`, then to the code variables `reserve_y3` and `shortfall` and constraints `Year3_Cash_Balance` and `Shortfall_Definition` (you may also reference `src/formulation.tex` symbols `y` and `s`). Identify which revised constraints are binding from the reported slack values, interpret the dual values 1.2 and -0.2 in business terms, and explain why a linear extrapolation of the -0.2 shadow price cannot be trusted for arbitrarily increasing the required reserve beyond 80000 yuan.
